events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: MTV, the iconic music television channel, launched on this day in 1981, with The Buggles' "Video Killed The Radio Star" being the first video ever played.

angles.name: MTV Impact
angles.copy: It's 1981 and a new channel changed music forever. Remember the first video ever played on MTV?

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe released
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album, "Definitely Maybe", on August 29th, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: A quarter-century ago, Oasis dropped an album that defined a generation. Still got 'Definitely Maybe' on repeat?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, began on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Rewind to '69: The Woodstock Festival opened its gates for three days of peace, love, and iconic music. Which performance do you wish you'd seen?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: The King Lives On
angles.copy: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of Elvis Presley. His music and legend continue to inspire. What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On September 18th, we remember the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix. His groundbreaking guitar work changed music forever.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, "Abbey Road", on September 26th, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: That album cover, those songs. The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' dropped on this day. A true masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad for it!
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the iconic Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger to British music.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album, "Imagine", on October 8th, 1971 in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: On this day, John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and unity resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first generation iPod, revolutionising portable music, on October 23rd, 2001.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember when your entire music library fit in your pocket? The first iPod was released on this day, changing how we listen forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, "Dr. No", in 1962.

angles.name: 007 Day
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic spy's cinematic debut. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day, we remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Thinking of John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His legacy of music and peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the "White Album", on November 22nd, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: The Beatles' iconic 'White Album' dropped on this day. A sprawling, diverse masterpiece. What's your favourite track from it?
